investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Pixelfold (photo sharing); Platform: Microsoft Azure West Europe; Kubernetes cluster: pf-weu-prod (AKS, node range 10.224.0.0/16); Object storage: Azure Blob Storage account holding originals and thumbnails; CDN in front of gallery-web; Deployments: Azure Pipelines releases with REL- identifiers; manual changes use CHG- identifiers.
